{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to account for bearish market pressure.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates > ±10% from recent 5-day average, adjust toward the average.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive (sentiment = 0 or >0) to capture potential rebound.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, reduce volatility in the later half of the forecast horizon if sentiment is stable or mildly positive.",
    "When sentiment rises above 0.5, increase forecast momentum slightly to reflect bullish sentiment, but cap at 15% above recent peak.",
    "If forecast consistently underperforms (e.g., 3 consecutive days below true outcome), shift toward higher values by 5-10% in next forecast window."
  ]
}
